_maintainer_note: The RAM-first local-model ladder the setup wizard fits against. Rules, so this stays honest as models rotate: (1) min_ram_gb is the floor of TOTAL system RAM to run the model at all; rec_ram_gb is where it is comfortable with room for the knowledge index. (2) A model is only offered on hardware that meets its floor. (3) benchmarks are measured on real silicon ONLY, keyed by an id in the 'silicon' map; a model or a hardware class we have not benched carries NO numbers and the wizard says 'untested, reports welcome'. Never extrapolate a number. (4) All models are local Ollama tags. There is no cloud model here, by design. As of this release exactly ONE board has been benched (see 'silicon'), so almost every model here carries no numbers and the wizard says so; that is the honest state, not an omission. Add rows as models rotate; add silicon entries as new boards get benched, and attach the measured numbers under the model's 'benchmarks'.

models.label: Qwen3 30B
models.strength: Our reference brain. A mixture of experts, so it carries 30B breadth on a ~3B speed budget, and it is strong at the structured tool-routing the agent team needs.

models.label: Qwen2.5 7B
models.strength: A solid all-rounder that fits mid-range boxes and still handles the house intents.

models.label: Qwen2.5 3B
